name: Pushing a phase gadget through a CNOT
summary: A phase gadget on the target of a CNOT gains (or loses) the control qubit when pushed through it.
description:
A phase gadget on a set of qubits S that contains the target but not the control of a CNOT can be pushed through the CNOT, after which it also acts on the control qubit. Conversely, if S contains both control and target, pushing it through removes the control (read the rule from right to left). This is because the CNOT maps the parity $x_c\oplus x_t$ to $x_t$.

When the gadget acts only on the target, it is a Z-phase on the target, and pushing it through gives a two-qubit gadget; this is the basis of [building gadgets from CNOTs](../phase-gadget-cnot-conjugation/). The rule follows from spider fusion and the [bialgebra rule](../bialgebra/), and is central to phase-polynomial and Pauli-exponential circuit synthesis.
parameter_notes: Shown for a gadget on the target and one further qubit; it holds for gadgets on any number of qubits.
